scope: One adaptive exploratory TRAIN optimization control after four-group learnability diagnostic; not independent validation or final quality

inputs.features: Original verified ordered XCLIP unit512D windows

projection.weighting: Equal total mass for each train-fold video, uniform among its windows
projection.solver: float64 weighted covariance eigh; descending eigenvalues, largest-absolute loading positive
projection.fit_scope: All windows of train-fold videos only; no held group, TUNE or HOLDOUT

head.padding: Replicate own endpoints before batching and in convolution; never across videos
head.batch: Every train-fold video in one padded batch
head.checkpoint: Last iterate only; no early stopping, seed search or hyperparameter search

supervision.positive: BCE at nearest center to official positive point; other positions unlabeled, context only
supervision.negative: BCE on maximum valid window logit per officially negative video
supervision.loss: 0.5 mean positive-video loss +0.5 mean negative-video loss
supervision.point_limit: Single nonexhaustive point, not event boundaries or exhaustive type truth

evaluation.method: Leave one entire existing automatic group out; exact contents deduplicated

point_gate: Separately require nonregression of all-positive candidate point MAE and common-TP paired MAE; never compare TP MAE of different cohorts as a gain
retention: Private fold predictions and fitted arrays remain local. Aggregate metrics/resources only outward. Preserve baseline, original cache, split and source videos
final_train_pack: One additional fixed full-TRAIN fit after CV, same parameters, saved privately even if gate fails; no in-sample quality claim, type/rule binding or deployment promotion
stop: One registered run; no changes or rerun after quality result. Failed gate is preserved. No TUNE/HOLDOUT evaluation or competition-readiness claim

recipe_selection.selection: Exact positive-control B bundle; no causal attribution to any individual changed hyperparameter
recipe_selection.cv_independence: Recipe selected after inspecting four TRAIN groups; subsequent OOF is adaptive exploratory, including remaining groups

strata: Same OOF predictions only: all24 primary, diagnostic-exposed4 and remaining20 secondary; whole groups included, no extra fits
